title: Software Discovery & Entitlement Reconciliation (SCCM / Intune / Flexera)
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (technical SAM core: normalize discovery data from SCCM/Intune/Flexera and reconcile to entitlements; multi-source, conditional logic).
Distinct from device-enrollment-identity-asset-inventory (hardware/device inventory): this product is SOFTWARE-install discovery normalized and reconciled to license entitlements.
hook: Turn raw software discovery into a clean, reconciled license position
problem: Discovery tools tell you what's installed — but raw inventory is noisy: thousands of unnormalized titles, editions and versions that don't map to SKUs, and no link to what you actually bought. This solution turns software discovery into a reconciled license position: pull installed-software data from Configuration Manager, Intune, or a discovery tool like Flexera, normalize it, map it to entitlements, and produce the reconciliation that drives compliance and reharvesting.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the discovery sources (Configuration Manager, Intune, Flexera), software normalization and SKU mapping, the entitlement reconciliation model, and how the output feeds compliance and optimization.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (a discovery source with inventory enabled, access/export rights, an entitlement system of record, a normalization approach) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing. Vendor-specific Flexera setup is deferred to the vendor's documentation.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: enable/confirm inventory, export installed-software data, normalize titles/editions/versions, map to entitlements, reconcile and flag exceptions, then pilot, validate, and expand to more sources.

5 PowerShell scripts — installed-software discovery (Intune/Configuration Manager), normalization/mapping validation, a reconciliation and exception report, safe remediation of mapping gaps, and a discovery-scope group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: Turn software discovery into a reconciled license position — pull installed-software data from Configuration Manager, Intune, or Flexera, normalize it, map it to entitlements, and produce the reconciliation that drives compliance and reharvesting. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
